data.acquisitionSummary: The legacy fixed 90-day passport/YKN blocker is stale. BTK Decision 2026/IK-THD/125 removed the old technical clauses that forced passport-registered foreign lines into the 90-day YKN-conversion shutdown path, effective 25 June 2026. Turkcell now offers a current Tourist SIM/eSIM flow using passport identity checks and Türkiye-arrival activation.

keep.action: Do not use the historical 90-day passport cap as the current retention rule. That technical rule was repealed in 2026; a current long-term Tourist-SIM inactivity/number-retention rule has not been established in this packet.

data.chinaActivation: Application can start online, but Turkcell states the Tourist line becomes usable after arrival in Türkiye. App self-activation for eSIM requires an eSIM/NFC phone, biometric passport scan, NFC passport read, liveness check and video contract confirmation.
data.kyc: Current Tourist flow accepts a valid passport; in-app activation requires a biometric passport. Türkiye strengthened electronic/biometric subscriber identity rules in 2026, while the old fixed 90-day YKN conversion clause was removed.
data.payment: Current Tourist application accepts debit/credit cards supporting international and online transactions.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: Current Turkcell Tourist package page says the package is valid only in Türkiye; this packet does not establish reliable overseas incoming OTP/SMS after departure.
data.refund: Turkcell states Tourist SIM refunds go back to the same credit card after cancellation through customer service.
data.holdReason: The old 90-day passport blocker is no longer current, but the route still lacks a verified long-term retention rule and overseas incoming-SMS path; activation/use is Türkiye-centered.
data.tariffSummary: Legacy 90-day YKN blocker repealed in 2026; current Tourist SIM supports passport-based online application/eSIM flow, but long-term retention and overseas OTP remain unverified.
guideSteps: HOLD: do not repeat the pre-June-2026 fixed 90-day passport-cap claim.
Treat as Türkiye tourist connectivity until current long-term retention and overseas OTP evidence exists.
